## Summary

Describe the user-visible or maintainer-visible change.

## Validation

- [ ] Relevant package tests pass.
- [ ] `pnpm run verify` passes from the workspace root.
- [ ] `pnpm run verify:integration` passes when the corpus contract changes.
- [ ] Documentation and examples match public behavior.
- [ ] No release, visibility, or compatibility gate is bypassed.

## Risk and rollback

Describe compatibility impact, operational risk, and the exact rollback path.
